card.title: Agent Stitch, You Are the Hero!

metadata.author: Disney
metadata.description:
Do you have what it takes to complete the mission? 

In this top secret interactive audio adventure YOU call the shots and YOU are the hero. Navigate the skies over London, use spy gadgets to solve mysteries and make important decisions along the way. Can you help Agent Stitch defeat the Glubglubs before they take over Earth?  

Throughout this exciting and immersive experience you will need to listen very carefully. There will be multiple choices and pathways for you to choose, using your Yoto player to confirm your decision by pressing the left and right hand buttons.  

What should Stitch do? Who will you choose to follow? What happens next? It’s a race against time and it’s up to YOU to save the day!
